def git(*args):return subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
def safe(path):
 path=Path(path)
 assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(repo) and not path.is_symlink(),str(path)
 for parent in path.parents:
  if parent==repo:break
  assert not parent.is_symlink(),str(parent)
 return path
def sha(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with safe(path).open('rb') as f:
  while chunk:=f.read(8*1024*1024):h.update(chunk)
 return h.hexdigest()
def descriptor(path):return dict(path=str(path),bytes=safe(path).stat().st_size,sha256=sha(path))
def read(path):return json.loads(safe(path).read_text())
def load(path,name):
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,safe(path));module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module);return module
def verify(folder,expected):
 manifest=folder/'SOURCE_MANIFEST.json';assert sha(manifest)==expected
 assert read(folder/'SEAL.json')['source_manifest_sha256']==expected
 rows=read(manifest)['files']
 for row in rows:
  path=safe(folder/row['path']);assert path.stat().st_size==row['bytes'] and sha(path)==row['sha256'],str(path)
 return dict(manifest=descriptor(manifest),payload_count=len(rows))

   item['descriptor']=descriptor(p)

  elif p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink():
   item['registered_receipts']=[dict(descriptor=descriptor(x),metadata=read(x)) for x in [p/'EXPORT_CLAIM.json',p/'PREDICTIONS_RECEIPT.json',p/'PHYSICAL_TERMINAL.json',p/'RUNNER_STARTED.json'] if x.is_file() and not x.is_symlink()]

 sys.exit(0)
